events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Drew Rasmussen allowed one hit through seven innings, Cedric Mullins drove in the only run of the game on a bunt single and the Tampa Bay Rays finished off a three-game sweep of the Cleveland Guardians with a 1-0 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rays hold Guardians to 1 hit, complete 3-game sweep with 1-0 victory

headlines.description: — CJ Abrams and James Wood both homered twice and drove in three runs as the Washington Nationals beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 10-7 on Sunday to take two of three games in their weekend series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Abrams and Wood each hit 2 homers as Nationals outslug Diamondbacks in 10-7 victory

headlines.description: — Matt Olson caught Gunnar Henderson's line drive and stepped on first for an improbable double play in the bottom of the 10th, and Austin Riley's RBI double an inning later lifted the Atlanta Braves to a 3-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves let Orioles tie it, then Atlanta escapes a bases-loaded jam in 10th before winning 3-2 in 11

headlines.description: — Ryan O’Hearn hit a grand slam on his 33rd birthday, and the Pittsburgh Pirates held off the Chicago Cubs 8-7 on Sunday to avoid being swept in the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan O'Hearn hits a grand slam on his 33rd birthday to lead Pirates to 8-7 victory over Cubs

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Jarren Duran drove in two runs with one of his three singles, Jahmai Jones had a pinch-hit two-run double and the Boston Red Sox beat the Toronto Blue Jays 6-1 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Surging Red Sox topple Blue Jays 6-1

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Michael Massey hit a go-ahead, two-run homer with two outs in the eighth inning and the Kansas City Royals held on to beat the Detroit Tigers...
headlines.shortLinkText: Michael Massey's 2-run, 2-out homer in 8th helps Royals beat Tigers 5-4 for 2nd straight win

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Tyrone Taylor put the Mets ahead with a three-run homer in the sixth inning, Marcus Semien added a three-run drive in the seventh and New York beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 8-3 on Sunday to prevent a season sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taylor and Semien each hit a 3-run homer as Mets beat Dodgers 8-3 to avoid season sweep

events.name: San Diego Padres at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Manny Machado and Jackson Merrill homered in the eighth inning and the San Diego Padres overcame an early three-run deficit to beat Miami 5-3 on Sunday, extending the Marlins’ losing streak to a franchise-record 12.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marlins' losing streak hits franchise-record 12 games with 5-3 loss to Padres

headlines.description: — Ryan Jeffers went 3 for 5 with three RBI, Connor Prielipp threw 5 2/3 innings of one-run ball in his return from the injured list and the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jeffers drives in 3 runs and Prielipp wins in return from IL as Twins beat Athletics 11-8

headlines.description: — Jacob Misiorowski struck out 12 of the first 13 batters he faced — including each of the first seven — and allowed only one hit over five...
headlines.shortLinkText: Misiorowski reaches milestones and Brewers go on hitting spree in 11-2 victory over Rockies

events.name: Houston Astros at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Munetaka Murakami homered twice and drove in a season-high six runs; Miguel Vargas, Chase Meidroth and Junior Perez also went deep as the Chicago White Sox beat the Houston Astros 12-3 on Sunday to avoid a series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murakami hits 2 HRs, drives in 6 runs to lead AL Central-leading White Sox past Astros 12-3

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart drove in the go-ahead run with a pinch-hit single in the 10th inning, and the Cincinnati Reds beat the St. Louis Cardinals 5-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reds beat Cardinals 5-3 in 10 innings to win 3 straight road series for first time since 2023

headlines.description: — Dominic Canzone put Seattle ahead with a three-run homer two pitches before Randy Arozarena also went deep in the seventh inning, and the Mariners rallied for a 6-4 victory over the Texas Rangers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dominic Canzone hits go-ahead 3-run homer as Mariners rally for 6-4 win over Rangers

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Mike Trout had his first four-hit game in more than five years, Jorge Soler and Jo Adell homered and the Los Angeles Angels beat the San...
headlines.shortLinkText: Trout's 1st 4-hit game since the 2021 season powers the Angels to a 4-3 win over the Giants

events.name: New York Yankees at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Bryson Stott homered, doubled and drove in five runs, NL All-Star starter Cristopher Sánchez pitched six solid innings and the Philadelphia Phillies avoided a three-game sweep with an 11-4 victory over the New York Yankees on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryson Stott homers and drives in 5 as Phillies rout Yankees 11-4 to avoid series sweep
